analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md (head lines 673-675). It adds a note that ModelCheckpointConversationLiveTests also records delta files and greedy output tokens, and that DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS=0 gives a complete-file baseline. This is a documentation-only change. No source, key handling, coordinator contract, attestation, or cache code changes. I checked it against T-041 (SSD prefix cache, at-rest artifacts, TTL, KEK/HMAC lookup). The documented procedure still uses an isolated ephemeral cache and an env -i-scrubbed environment; the test runner never touches production cache roots. The new env var is a test-only knob in the documented command context and is not presented as a production setting. It does not weaken the TTL, disk budget, HMAC naming, or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate. The doc mentions incremental/delta checkpoint files; whether the underlying provider source adds delta files with metadata or AAD content beyond the keyed lookup tag is outside the supplied evidence. That code is not in this PR's supplied units. T-041's detection_hint requires review of any DBK3 metadata or AAD change, so the reviewer of the source PR that introduced incremental checkpoints should confirm no prompt-derived plaintext metadata was added. The threat model likely needs a mention of delta checkpoint files if they are a distinct at-rest artifact. This is a coverage question, not a finding against this docs change. The rest of the file is unchanged context and I did not identify a security regression in it.
